note: Hand-authored ground truth. Other, unplanted weaknesses may exist (e.g. no CSRF protection, known advisories in the pinned dependency); only these are scored. Descriptions say what is wrong, never how to exploit it.

weaknesses.description: The search term is interpolated into the SQL text of the notes search instead of being bound as a parameter.
weaknesses.safe_confirmation_strategy: As a synthetic user, search with an ordinary term, then with a harmless malformed term; observe whether the response turns into a database error or changes shape in a way a bound parameter would not allow. Observation only.

weaknesses.description: A user's profile bio, which the user can change, is written into the public profile HTML without output encoding.
weaknesses.safe_confirmation_strategy: As a synthetic user, set the bio to a unique inert marker containing harmless HTML-special characters, then request the public profile page and observe whether the characters come back unencoded.

weaknesses.description: A note is fetched by id for any logged-in user; the handler never checks that the note belongs to the caller.
weaknesses.safe_confirmation_strategy: Log in as one synthetic user, request the id of a note that belongs to another synthetic user, and observe whether the note content is returned instead of a denial.

weaknesses.description: The endpoint that changes site-wide settings requires no login and no role check.
weaknesses.safe_confirmation_strategy: Without logging in, send a settings update that changes only a harmless synthetic key and observe whether it is accepted; restore the lab afterwards with the reset script. Lab targets only.

weaknesses.description: An unauthenticated debug route returns process environment, configuration and request headers, including a secret-like value.
weaknesses.safe_confirmation_strategy: Request the debug route without logging in and observe whether environment and configuration entries appear in the response.

weaknesses.description: The token-signing secret is hardcoded in source, and an old copy of the server file containing it sits in the public static folder.
weaknesses.safe_confirmation_strategy: Request the backup file name from the static path and observe whether source text with secret-like definitions is returned; the value itself must not be copied into any report.

weaknesses.description: The login endpoint accepts unlimited failed attempts with no throttling, delay or lockout.
weaknesses.safe_confirmation_strategy: Send a small bounded number of failed logins (well under ten) for a synthetic account and observe that no response ever changes (no delay, lockout or 429 status).

weaknesses.description: The session cookie is set without HttpOnly, SameSite or Secure attributes, and no security headers are sent on any response.
weaknesses.safe_confirmation_strategy: Log in as a synthetic user and inspect the Set-Cookie attributes and the response headers of any page; observe which cookie flags and standard security headers are missing.

weaknesses.description: Every response reflects the request origin into Access-Control-Allow-Origin and allows credentials.
weaknesses.safe_confirmation_strategy: Send a request that carries a synthetic Origin header and observe whether the same origin is echoed back together with a credentials-allowed header.

weaknesses.description: The error handler returns the internal error message and full stack trace, including file paths, to the client.
weaknesses.safe_confirmation_strategy: Send a request whose body is syntactically malformed JSON and observe whether the error response contains a stack trace or internal file paths.
